topic: A neighbor asks to use part of the yard for a garden
text: Well now, I reckon the soil by the eastern wall is fertile enough for a patch of greens. It’s been good to me, and I can see it’d do well for others too. Brother Thomas did mention how the saints favor those who share what little they have, and I’ve been thinking on that. Maybe if we tend it right, together, our plants might give a bit more than what we sow. Times are hard, and a little help from above or from a neighbor’s hands could mean a less lean winter. Let’s start when the first frost lifts, shall we? I’ll even show you my tricks for keeping the rabbits at bay.
